_note: Which model does which job, and what it costs. Triage is a sorting job, so it uses the cheapest current model at low effort. Drafting is writing under strict rules, so it uses the current mid-tier model at high effort (raise effort before moving up a tier). The Anthropic API reference's own default is claude-opus-5-5 at about twice the Sonnet price; change `draft.model` to that if drafts need more. Prices are dollars per million tokens (API reference, cached 2026-11-03) and are used only for the cost estimate in the pull request.
